summary: ProSync CRM (Italian dual-area energy/network). Backend: 15/15 pytest tests PASSED against public preview URL (auth register/login/me/duplicate, settings GET/PUT, contacts CRUD + notes + files, appointments CRUD + reschedule + done + outcome, callbacks CRUD with day filter, reports dual-area, google-session reachable returning 401 for fake session). Frontend: login screen renders all requested testIDs (auth-tab-login/register, auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-button, auth-google-button). Email/password login succeeds and routes to /home. Home shows home-greeting 'Ciao, Mario', stat-energy, stat-network, qa-new-appt, qa-new-contact. Contatti tab shows contacts-add-btn, contacts-search, filter-all, filter-energy, filter-network. Calendario shows cal-add-btn and 14 day-* tiles. Report shows period-day/week/month/year + report-energy + report-network. Impostazioni shows settings-energy-title, settings-network-title, settings-save, logout-btn, 8 energy-color-* swatches, 8 network-color-* swatches. E2E create contact via UI succeeded (created c_4f60079dcc42 'TEST_UI Auto', Networker area, phone +39 111 222). Google OAuth button present; backend endpoint returns 401 on fake session_id as expected. Deprecated packages: none. Two RN-web non-blocking console warnings observed (shadow* and pointerEvents style props). Note: new-contact/new-appointment form testIDs use 'c-*'/'ap-*' prefixes (e.g. c-first-name, c-save-btn, ap-title, ap-save) rather than the 'contact-*'/'appt-*' names in the review request - naming discrepancy only; forms function correctly.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Emitted by multiple components (statCard in home.tsx, segItemActive in login.tsx, etc.)
Non-blocking deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents (comes from react-native-web layer).

action_items: OPTIONAL naming alignment: review-request lists testIDs like 'contact-first-name/appt-title' but implementation uses 'c-first-name/ap-title'. If strict alignment desired, rename testIDs in /app/frontend/app/contact/new.tsx and /app/frontend/app/appointment/new.tsx. Not a functional bug.
OPTIONAL: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: register duplicate returns 400; login returns 401 on bad creds; JWT with 30d exp; all endpoints guarded by get_current_user; _id stripped from responses; contacts/appointments/callbacks scoped to user_id.
api.ts: uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly, throws on non-OK with parsed detail.
auth.tsx: handles web session_id extraction from URL for Google flow before regular refresh.
server.py:668 uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown - consider migrating to lifespan handler (non-blocking).
Files stored as base64 inline in MongoDB per spec; no server-side size limit - E1 may want to add max payload guard for large PDFs.
